title: Task requests
description: Post and manage buyer requests for quotes, custom work, or procurement.

help.title: About Task requests
help.overview: A task request is a buyer brief seeking quotes: title, description, category, budget, location, and media. It opens for bids for 30 days. Providers with an active listing in the same category and city can be notified.

sections.title: Statuses
items: Closed — stopped without an award; pending bidders are notified.
Awarded — a bid was accepted; status cannot be changed further from close/reopen.

sections.title: Actions
items: Close — from open; notifies users who still have a pending bid.
Reopen — from closed; resets the 30-day bidding window so an expired request is not closed again immediately.
Notify all — alerts matching providers again (active listing in the same category and city).
Only the requester (or an admin) can change status this way.

sections.title: How it connects
items: Bids attach to the task request; accepting a bid awards the request and creates an order.
Category and city drive provider matching — keep them accurate.
Soft delete is available; restore brings the row back.
